la:adv:eadem.html:
eādem, adv.
abl. f., from idem, sc. viā, operā, or parte
.
By the same way (rare): ut ventum est in trivium, eadem qua ceteri fugere noluit,: eadem revertens,: eadem et Romanos sequentes impetus rapit,.—
Transf.
(Sc. operā, sometimes expressed, ; ; prop., by the same piece of work, i. e.) At the same time, likewise (ante-class.), (cf. Brix. ad loc.) eādem ego ex hoc quae volo exquaesivero, . atque eādem mulieres apparebunt, .—
Repeated: eadem ... eadem, now ... now, at one time ... at another: eadem biberis, eadem dedero tibi ubi biberis savium, (15).
